news.title: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z.  Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
news.description: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

news.title: Supreme Court Justice Alito said he's 'thought about' retirement as Senate control hangs in balance
news.description: The Senate could flip to Democrats after November's midterm election, jeopardizing a potential Supreme Court nomination by President Donald Trump.

news.title: Ukraine’s surprise robot offensive exposes a vulnerability in Putin’s war machine
news.description: Experts say the offensive is not a decisive breakthrough, but demonstrates how Ukraine’s expanding use of robotic systems is reshaping frontline warfare.
